verdict: Ads are running, but leads aren't reaching you — that's the priority.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, $1,564.56 in Google Ads spend produced 15 reported conversions and 133 clicks, yet zero leads are recorded as reaching your pipeline — pointing to a breakdown between ad response and intake, not a failure of the ads themselves. Your Google Business Profile went quiet over the final four days of the period (Aug 15–18), with calls, direction requests, and web clicks all dropping to zero after a 64% week-over-week decline, which signals reduced local search activity likely tied to late-summer seasonal softening. On the intake side, 44 opportunities were opened in your system against 78 contacts, but no appointments were booked and no pipeline value was logged — the gap is in how inquiries are being processed, not in how many are arriving. Confirming your intake owner and completing the booking automation test, both targeted for August 31, are the immediate actions in motion to close this. Heading into September, Local Services Ads are set to re-enable for heating season, which should rebuild top-of-funnel momentum as demand shifts.
